key_insight: Evidence-grounded language models guided perovskite contact design, selecting a K analogue that outperformed the expert-preferred Na analogue in experiments.
engineering_relevance: The selected contact enabled 27.05% power conversion efficiency and 96.74% efficiency retention after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence; refine selected answers with retrieved evidence in OpenPerov Pro.
Evaluate scientific reasoning and experimentally test a model-selected self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal ageing result does not establish durability under illumination or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
